description: Cross-sections of the client's pending absorbers reduced from ExoMol line lists (rendering plan R08, R08.T4.c; decision-r08-t4b-t12c.md, follow-ups 3 and 4): per species or pair and task, its 1 nm cell-mean cross-sections over 380-760 nm at its source's temperature nodes: cellMeansM2, m2 a molecule, or cellMeansM5, m5 a molecule pair, one row of 381 cells a node, the cells centred on 380, 381, ..., 760 nm, each [nm - 0.5, nm + 0.5) on vacuum wavelengths, rounded up to 3 significant figures so that each stays a bound. Adapted material of the ExoMol database, offered under CC BY-SA 4.0 (README.md beside this file, and NOTICE).

bounds.source: ExoMol line list POKAZATEL v20230621 (O. L. Polyansky et al., MNRAS 480 (2018) 2597, DOI 10.1093/mnras/sty1877) (via https://www.exomol.com, the cross-section service https://www.exomol.com/xsec/1H2-16O/, Doppler profiles, 1 cm-1 bins over 13100-26400 cm-1); .sigma SHA-256 1000 K 55a9b13de2c4263fd9ba85271777034f91556bbacaf9aa2de4ddc23c4a09d1b9, 2000 K 578c266160cfbd5b657ea2ee87384525261bd4dcb9bba5fd3a126ef658fcd16f, 3000 K 1ad3264fb006bbce188a5684e051afb2d27bc3a29aaf48e65d4b2f4adab84cdd, 4000 K 615187f2306b23d9a525e1bbcc76ee09f160afb81abc94c6706d51dd67771a60; fetched 2026-10-11
bounds.method: Each 1 cm-1 bin of the service's cross-sections in the cell holding its centre; each 1 nm vacuum cell's mean over 380-760 nm at each node. Per molecule of 1H2-16O.

bounds.source: ExoMol line list AYT2 v20241204 (A. A. A. Azzam et al., MNRAS 460 (2016) 4063, DOI 10.1093/mnras/stw1133; dataset DOI 10.5281/zenodo.5716826) (via https://www.exomol.com, https://www.exomol.com/db/H2S/1H2-32S/AYT2/); states.bz2 SHA-256 52cf071aee6af131bcf2dc950434e7e7b4756cdaf893a4a0e5fcb91d9b4cda13, .pf 786beaca5627d4f318324983de8bc8104a2f11d33890657260adc610374910a3 and the 14 transition files of 13000-27000 cm-1; fetched 2026-10-10
bounds.method: Direct sum over AYT2's 6.61e6 transitions in range with its own partition sums; each 1 nm vacuum cell's mean over 380-760 nm at each node. The (6 0 0) band dominates (59-63% of the cell). Above the bound at 296 K already, so pending from 296 K.

bounds.source: ExoMol line list Harris v20161205 (G. J. Harris et al., MNRAS 367 (2006) 400; R. J. Barber et al., MNRAS 437 (2014) 1828; dataset DOI 10.5281/zenodo.5716828) (via https://www.exomol.com, https://www.exomol.com/db/HCN/1H-12C-14N/Harris/); trans.bz2 SHA-256 df87d95d9bf81af24a4a6b3626a8227ff4bbb31602760a7e7b0d80da3bf10ca1, states.bz2 631f775e2d8096461333837c5bb4881a11533d851c774df3da1d1698c556516a, .pf 028f4b42b3ef9bf9527b172b9b89a7dd47259d8b1bf556de0fd201684968b4f4; fetched 2026-10-11
bounds.method: Direct sum over the list's 4804 transitions in range; each 1 nm vacuum cell's mean over 380-760 nm at each node. Marked estimated: the list holds few hot bands in the range, so its hot values are lower limits of the opacity, and the hundredfold margin covers them.

bounds.source: ExoMol line list TYM v20240527 (S. N. Yurchenko, T. M. Mellor and J. Tennyson, MNRAS 534 (2024) 1364, DOI 10.1093/mnras/stae2201) (via https://www.exomol.com, the cross-section service https://www.exomol.com/xsec/14N2-16O/, Doppler profiles, 1 cm-1 bins over 13100-19999 cm-1); .sigma SHA-256 296 K 0ccb99a743877d030da7057813626e1429d4475b29c67485024882fca3d9ad42, 1000 K 2dcddd399a8cb4e347b26388961df037e0764e0b1da65e565569b6b435a553c3, 2000 K ee9277a1ed18279c821d90c6b5660f7a9ab0af43ea233b4ba71cfa0cd332af3c; fetched 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-11
bounds.method: Each 1 cm-1 bin of the service's cross-sections in the cell holding its centre; each 1 nm vacuum cell's mean over 380-760 nm at each node. TYM ends at 20000 cm-1 (500 nm), so the cells below it are 0; at 296 K it agrees with HITRAN2024 at 714 nm within 11%.

bounds.source: ExoMol line list C2018 for 14NH3, version 20170131 (P. A. Coles, R. I. Ovsyannikov, O. L. Polyansky, S. N. Yurchenko and J. Tennyson, J. Quant. Spectrosc. Radiat. Transfer 219 (2018) 199-212, DOI 10.1016/j.jqsrt.2018.07.022), https://www.exomol.com/db/NH3/14N-1H3/C2018/; def.json SHA-256 f8ce0d6176baf7f4d585b30a19c4a4ec6515def26d902c1da8d2f73a2ac7bba0, states.bz2 58af64e31a8de20d7b99fe685d7bbb12f06d51a34580e5ba4dc9e8030934147a and the 7 transition files of 13000-20000 cm-1 (their SHA-256 in exomol/kDistributions/NH3.json); fetched 2026-10-13
bounds.method: C2018's 300 K cell means, R08.T4.g's table's last node, kept for the profiles above C2018's 300 K, where R08.T4.g's k-distribution table (100-300 K) is held at its 300 K node and estimated until R08.T4.f, which considers ExoMol's CoYuTe list for hot NH3 (P. A. Coles, S. N. Yurchenko and J. Tennyson, MNRAS 490 (2019) 4638). Direct sum over C2018's 244.6 million lines of 13100-20000 cm-1, Q(300) 1761.60 summed from its states file, times HITRAN's natural abundance of 14NH3 (0.995872): each line in the 1 nm vacuum cell holding its centre, its integral over wavelength S / nu^2, over the cell's 1 nm; the largest cell 645 nm (2e-28 m2). C2018 holds too few hot bands to be complete above 300 K, so a lower limit there, estimated. Each value rounded up to 3 significant figures.
